title: Missing doc comments on public API items
description: Library crate with undocumented public surface. Missing docs on: constants (FRAGMENT_M/N/T, ALL_1_FCN, MIC_LENGTH, etc.), struct fields (Fragment, Ack, FragmentSender, FragmentReceiver), many public methods (compute_mic, write_to, from_bytes, etc.). As a library crate, documentation is part of the contract. Should add /// doc comments to all pub items.
